decision: Accept the bounded TQP-23 reference surface-shading scope and advance the qualification program without claiming production visual quality.
reason: The project owner approved progress after reviewing the live guided fixture and the reported moving-shadow concern. The analytical shader corpus passes, the retained near and far captures are deterministic, all guided diagnostic captures pass their automated checks, and the 0.25 m native fixture reports zero seam errors, zero interior openings, and zero non-manifold edges. TQP-F001 remains open because the cast-shadow silhouette is resolution-limited and must be judged in the broader TQP-25 visual corpus. This decision accepts only the declared reference behavior and does not treat uncertainty about final production appearance as proof of production quality.
qualified_scope: tangent-free triplanar normal reorientation and stable analytical tangents
slope, global-height, wetness, and world-projected diagnostic masks
fixed near and far camera detail behavior
guided diagnostic inspection on the 0.25 m native fixture
held_scope: TQP-F001 shadow silhouette smoothness and TQP-25 visual-quality acceptance
production art direction, textures, decals, and weather
explicit_non_claims: no claim that cast shadows are smooth at every terrain resolution
no GPU performance or cross-platform renderer qualification
